content: OpenVPN Key Method 2 derives keys via openvpn_PRF (crypto.c/ssl.c), which delegates to ssl_tls1_PRF — the legacy RFC 2246 TLS 1.0 PRF: split secret into two overlapping halves, run P_hash HMAC expansion with MD5 on one half and SHA1 on the other, XOR the two output streams. Not exposed by Go stdlib crypto/tls (unexported prf10 in src/crypto/tls/prf.go) but trivially reimplementable with crypto/md5+crypto/sha1+crypto/hmac. Two-stage: pre-master->master secret, then master->key expansion, each its own PRF call with a label.
